hypothesised_pattern: The sign of the residual is set by whether x2 and x5 agree in sign, with large |x4| adding a further upward push, a bilinear-plus-quadratic structure the base model misses.
rationale: All seven positive-residual rows (targets 0.56-0.88) have x2*x5 > 0 (about 0.29 to 3.5), and all three negative-residual rows (targets 0.22-0.25) have x2*x5 < 0 (about -0.6 to -1.2). Rows 2 and 6 have nearly equal x4 (-0.676 vs -0.720) but opposite residuals, which the x2*x5 sign explains; row 5, with the smallest product (0.29), has the largest |x4| (2.375), so the x4**2 term is still needed.
